item.title: Make My Photo Look Professional

turns.text: Make me look professional in this photo.

item.tests: Uses reasonable defaults for a vague professional portrait request without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: The portrait shows the same man, retaining his short grey hair and recognisable facial features.
His casual T-shirt is replaced with professional clothing such as a collared shirt or blazer.
The kitchen setting is replaced or simplified into an unobtrusive professional backdrop.
Harsh facial lighting is softened while retaining realistic skin texture.
The result is a clean head-and-shoulders portrait without visible editing artifacts.

turns.text: Make me look professional in this photo.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t create the professional edit because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was generated.

Once credits are available, I can add a navy blazer, a light-blue shirt, a neutral background, and flattering lighting while keeping your features natural.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Turn this photo into a polished, photorealistic professional headshot of the same man. Preserve his identity, facial features, age, short gray hair, natural skin texture and light facial stubble. Replace the casual gray T-shirt with a well-tailored navy blazer over a crisp light blue collared shirt, open collar without tie. Replace the kitchen with a simple softly blurred neutral gray studio background. Use flattering soft studio lighting, balanced exposure and natural skin tones. Head and shoulders composition, upright confident posture, approachable subtle expression, looking at camera. Realistic tasteful retouching only, no plastic skin, no age reduction, no text.
